title: The $C^*$--ISR Property for $\text{PSL}_n(\mathbb{Z})$
summary: A discrete group $Γ$ has the \emph{$C^*$--ISR property} if every unital $Γ$--invariant $C^*$--subalgebra $A\subseteq C_r^*(Γ)$ is of the form $C_r^*(N)$ for a normal subgroup $N\triangleleftΓ$. We show that $\text{PSL}_n(\mathbb{Z})$ satisfies the $C^*$--ISR property for every $n\geq3$.
